description: Add Audio to Video — The supplied audio replaces the original soundtrack and the result is MP4. One video and one audio file, up to 500 MB each.. Video And Audio Studio run — processes in the browser but uses more credits per run than the Document / Image / Scanner workspaces. Welcome credits cover a limited number of runs. Day Pass does not include this workspace. All three credit-based workspaces unlock with the same one-time credit pack — there is no per-workspace subscription. See mioffice.ai/pricing for current plans.
